Write the general term $T_{r+1}$ in the binomial expansion of $\left(2x - \frac{1}{4x^2}\right)^9$:
$$T_{r+1} = \binom{9}{r}(2x)^{9-r}\left(-\frac{1}{4x^2}\right)^r = \binom{9}{r}2^{9-r}x^{9-r}\left(\frac{(-1)^r}{2^{2r}x^{2r}}\right) = \binom{9}{r}(-1)^r 2^{9-3r}x^{9-3r}$$

To find the term independent of $x$, equate the exponent of $x$ to $0$:
$$9 - 3r = 0 \implies 3r = 9 \implies r = 3$$

Evaluate the constant term for $r = 3$:
$$\text{Term independent of } x = \binom{9}{3}(-1)^3 2^{9-9} = 84(-1)(1) = -84$$
